refsect1.title: DESCRIPTION
refsect1.para: This reference entry lists the Bib-1 attribute set types and values, including registered extensions through Use attribute 1225 (Provider, approved in 2014). Bib-1 is maintained separately from the Z39.50-2003 standard in the Maintenance Agency's registry. Index Data extensions are identified below.

refsect1.title: TYPES
refsect1.para: The Bib-1 attribute set defines six attribute types: Use (1), Relation (2), Position (3), Structure (4), Truncation (5) and Completeness (6).
